# Valley Pawn - Enterprise Changelog

Newest first. Material changes to the business operating system. Read this BEFORE any build, fix or diagnosis.

## 2026-11-17 (weekly email — closed test loop LIVE; report fix live)

- Joshua: "you give feedback but never follow or execute your recommendations." NEW `bin/email_test_loop.py` + `.sh`: `apply` (Mon 13:15 after the deal picker, retries Tue/Wed 09:20) puts promoted winners on Thursday's queued weekly, then splits lists 7+13 into two random halves (new auto lists "Weekly test loop - half A/B"), control -> A, cloned variant "<name> [B]" -> B, same send time, seeds on both. The variant is created only after the control is verified on half A; any failure deletes the variant and restores [7,10,13]. `grade` (Fri 03:50, after analytics) scores store actions per 1,000 (call+text+directions buckets), WIN/LOSE at z>=1.28 after >=2 sends and >=20 actions, NO DIFFERENCE at 6 sends; winners are promoted onto every weekly. Backlog `Email Refinement/test_loop/backlog.json` (T1 top call/text strip, T2 text-a-photo quote, T3 no-appointment preview line, T4 directions strip). Results log `Email Refinement/test_loop/RESULTS.md`. Never touches offers, loan/legal copy or audiences. Offline tests passed (transforms idempotent, skip on missing links, split 50/50, decision table).
- `bin/email_analytics_weekly.py` (backup `fleet/_backups/email_analytics_weekly.py.bak-pre-testloop-20261117`): arrows now show the real direction plus good/worse (11/13 report printed unsubscribes 0.1 -> 0 as "↑"); a metric needs 5+ real events to lead or get an arrow ("too few to read"); A/B halves merge into one weekly row for the trend; the recommendation line is replaced by the loop's status/result when the loop is on.
- ON (Joshua 17:30 'ok turn it on'): allow-list += email_test_loop.py/.sh (backup `fleet/_backups/host_queue_allowlist.txt.bak-pre-testloop-20261117`); `com.valleypawn.email-test-loop-apply` (Mon 13:15, Tue/Wed 09:20) + `-grade` (Fri 03:50) bootstrapped via install_agent.sh. Visible strips go after the email's hidden preview text. First live split verified: Thu 11/19 #64 -> list 31 half A (455) + seeds, #92 '[B]' T1 top strip -> list 32 half B (454) + seeds, both queued 10:00. First grade Fri 11/27 (needs 2 sends).
